errors.evidence: The largest sector is «Кашони» with 24.67%. «Продукти в търговска опаковка» (the label seems to be shortened to «Продукти в опаковка» in the description) is only 17.51%.

The description fails to correctly identify and describe the largest slice of the pie chart, which is «Кашони» with a value of 24.67%. While the label «Кашони» is mentioned, it is incorrectly assigned a value of 8.75%.
